scope: Newest completed eligible machine cycle under T0 workgraph backpressure. Cumulative evidence reused; no ordinary fresh names opened and no optional polishing performed.
summary: TER and SERV remain narrow exception work rather than broad re-underwriting candidates. TER's stale legacy-convertible concern is eliminated by primary evidence; its remaining reproducibility gate is current 2026 SBC/debt/repurchase normalization. SERV has a reproducible Q2 cash anchor; its remaining gate is exact cash-flow/equity-overhang/concentration extraction. The 2200Z machine cycle introduced no contradictory evidence requiring restart.

claims: Legacy 1.25% convertible notes matured in 2023 and associated warrants expired by July 10, 2024; they are historical dilution rather than current exposure.
Current underwriting treatment therefore depends on 2026 SBC/governance dilution, current debt balances and executed repurchases.
risks: Stale share counts could miss 2026 SBC/repurchase effects; treating extinguished convertibles as current would overstate risk.
unknowns: 2026 basic/fully diluted share count, unvested awards, current debt balances and repurchase execution.
evidence.exactGate: Normalize current 2026 SBC/governance dilution, current debt and executed repurchases using the 2026 definitive proxy plus latest 2026 10-Q; exclude matured notes and expired warrants from current exposure.
evidence.nextLawfulSourcePath: Teradyne 2026 definitive proxy equity-compensation tables and latest 2026 Form 10-Q debt/equity/share-count notes.

claims: Serve reported $79.112M cash and cash equivalents at June 30, 2026 versus $106.239M at December 31, 2025 in its Q2 2026 Form 10-Q.
That anchor avoids redundant source hunting but does not alone make survival/dilution/concentration treatment reproducible.
risks: Cash declined over H1; runway depends on operating cash use and financing capacity.
ATM/warrant/SBC capacity may create material dilution.
Early customer/partner concentration can amplify revenue volatility.
unknowns: Exact H1 operating cash use, unused ATM capacity, warrant/SBC overhang and current customer/partner concentration percentages.
evidence.exactGate: Extract from Q2 2026 10-Q the H1 operating cash use, current ATM/equity issuance capacity, warrant/SBC overhang and customer/partner concentration so survival/dilution/concentration are reproducible.
evidence.nextLawfulSourcePath: Serve Robotics Q2 2026 Form 10-Q cash-flow statement plus equity/warrant, revenue/customer concentration and commitments notes; incorporated ATM prospectus only if needed for remaining capacity.
